title: On the Geometrical and Kinematical Foundations of the Symmetric Relativity Model: Lorentz Transformation and Time Dilation
summary: We examine the kinematic foundations of relativity by considering two inertial frames, $S$ and $S'$, in a standard configuration, where $S'$ moves along the common spatial $x$-axis at a constant velocity $v$. By relaxing Einstein's second postulate regarding the universal invariance of the one-way speed of light, we adopt an operational framework grounded strictly on the directly observable two-way (round-trip) speed of light, evaluated alongside the principles of spacetime homogeneity, linearity, and reciprocity.
